subtasks.objective: Prevent direct client invocation of KOT generation for arbitrary POS Invoice IDs by removing or restricting the whitelisted `kot_execute` entry point while preserving legitimate server-side KOT creation from URY order update and cancellation flows.
subtasks.acceptance: `kot_execute` can no longer be used by an authenticated user to create new or cancel KOT documents for an arbitrary invoice without authorization; legitimate order update and cancel paths still create the expected KOT/cancel-KOT records; any remaining whitelisted replacement validates POS Invoice permissions and branch/profile access before generating KOTs; focused tests or manual Frappe checks cover denied direct calls and allowed order flows.
